description: This file defines a static utility class 'TestExtensions' that provides extension methods for tasks to implement timeout functionality with cancellation support. The methods allow adding a timeout to any task, cancelling if it exceeds the specified duration, and throwing a TimeoutException if timed out.

classes.name: TestExtensions
classes.description: A static class containing extension methods for task timeout handling.

methods.name: WithTimeout
methods.description: Extension method that adds a timeout to a Task, cancels the task if the timeout elapses, and throws TimeoutException.

methods.name: WithTimeout<T>
methods.description: Generic extension method for Task<T> that adds a timeout similarly to the non-generic version, returning the task result if completed in time.
